name: Sumoto (Kumamoto, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Sumoto town emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs crossed by a vertical bar with a small ring.
history: Flag of the former town of Sumoto in Kumamoto Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-27.
